arxiv-1905-06520.title: Blockchain Goes Green? An Analysis of Blockchain on Low-Power Nodes
arxiv-1905-06520.creator: Dumitrel Loghin, Gang Chen, Tien Tuan Anh Dinh, Beng Chin Ooi, Yong Meng Teo
arxiv-1905-06520.description: Abstract Motivated by the massive energy usage of blockchain, on the one hand, and by significant performance improvements in low-power, wimpy systems, on the other hand, we perform an in-depth time-energy analysis of blockchain systems on low-power nodes in comparison to high-performance nodes.

arxiv-2312-13688.title: Parameter dependence of entanglement spectra in quantum field theories
arxiv-2312-13688.creator: Wu-zhong Guo, Jin Xu
arxiv-2312-13688.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore the characteristics of reduced density matrix spectra in quantum field theories. Previous studies mainly focus on the function 𝒫 ⁡ ( λ ) := ∑ i δ ⁡ ( λ − λ i ) \mathcal{P}(\lambda):=\sum_{i}\delta(\lambda-\lambda_{i}) , where λ i \lambda_{i} denote the eigenvalues of the reduced density matirx.

arxiv-2403-15579.title: Efficient first principles based modeling via machine learning: from simple representations to high entropy materials
arxiv-2403-15579.creator: Kangming Li, Kamal Choudhary, Brian DeCost, Michael Greenwood, Jason Hattrick-Simpers
arxiv-2403-15579.description: Abstract High-entropy materials (HEMs) have recently emerged as a significant category of materials, offering highly tunable properties. However, the scarcity of HEM data in existing density functional theory (DFT) databases, primarily due to computational expense, hinders the development of effective modeling strategies for computational materials discovery.

arxiv-2408-07364.title: Robust Active Learning (RoAL): Countering Dynamic Adversaries in Active Learning with Elastic Weight Consolidation Journal: Knowledge based system
arxiv-2408-07364.creator: Ricky Maulana Fajri, Yulong Pei, Lu Yin, Mykola Pechenizkiy
arxiv-2408-07364.description: Abstract Despite significant advancements in active learning and adversarial attacks, the intersection of these two fields remains underexplored, particularly in developing robust active learning frameworks against dynamic adversarial threats. The challenge of developing robust active learning frameworks under dynamic adversarial attacks is critical, as these attacks can lead to catastrophic forgetting within the active learning cycle.

arxiv-2501-15723.title: Quasi-aperiodic grain boundary phases of Σ ​ 5 \Sigma 5 tilt grain boundaries in refractory metals
arxiv-2501-15723.creator: Enze Chen, Timofey Frolov
arxiv-2501-15723.description: Abstract We report new ground-state structures and phase transitions in Σ \Sigma 5[001] tilt grain boundaries (GBs) in body-centered cubic (BCC) refractory metals Nb, Ta, Mo, and W. Σ \Sigma 5 tilt GBs have been extensively investigated over the past several decades, with their ground-state structure—composed of kite-shaped structural units—previously thought to be well understood.

pmc-11428568.title: Thyroid functions and insulin resistance in pregnant Sudanese women
pmc-11428568.creator: Wisal Abbas, Abdelmageed Elmugabil, Duria A Rayis, Ishag Adam, Hamdan Z Hamdan
pmc-11428568.description: BackgroundThe thyroid function test (free triiodothyronine [FT3], free thyroxine [FT4], and thyroid-stimulating hormone [TSH]) is one of the key determinant of glucose homeostasis by regulating the balance of insulin. Thyroid dysfunction alters glucose metabolism, leading to insulin resistance (IR). This study aimed to assess the association between thyroid function and IR in pregnant Sudanese women.

pmc-11450277.title: Inhibitory Effect of Phenolic Compounds on Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor-Induced Retinal Endothelial Permeability and Angiogenesis
pmc-11450277.creator: Dong Yoon Kim, Seong-Min Hong, Jeong-Seok Cho, Sae-Byuk Lee, Hyun-Dong Cho
pmc-11450277.description: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD), often triggered by endothelial barrier disruption through vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), is a leading cause of blindness. This study investigated the inhibitory effects of phenolic compounds on VEGF-induced endothelial cell proliferation, migration, angiogenesis, and permeability using human retinal microvascular endothelial cells (hRECs).

pmc-11455151.title: 12217 Exploring Thyroid-stimulating Hormone As A Potential Cardiovascular Disease Risk Marker In Euthyroid Individuals
pmc-11455151.creator: Alfredo Pinheiro Neto, Henrique Lucchesi, Carolina Castro Porto Silva Janovsky, Isabela Bensenor, Laura Sterian Ward, Lucas Leite Cunha
pmc-11455151.description: Disclosure: A.P. Neto: None. H. Lucchesi: None. C.C. Silva Janovsky: None. I. Bensenor: None. L.S. Ward: None. L.L. Cunha: None.Previous studies have suggested that TSH levels may predict longevity primarily in elderly individuals. Aging is associated with a high prevalence of cardiovascular and metabolic diseases that reduce survival.

pmc-11663707.title: The potato sugar transporter SWEET1g affects apoplasmic sugar ratio and phloem-mobile tuber- and flower-inducing signals
pmc-11663707.creator: Angelique Lauschke, Leonie Maibaum, Mira Engel, Luise Eisengräber, Sina Bayer, Aleksandra Hackel, Christina Kühn
pmc-11663707.description: The main phloem loader in potato, sucrose transporter StSUT1, is coexpressed with 2 members of the SWEET gene family: StSWEET11b, a clade III member of SWEET carriers assumed to be involved in sucrose efflux, and StSWEET1g, a clade I member involved in glucose efflux into the apoplast, that physically interacts with StSUT1.

pmc-11728749.title: Unmasking the Invisible Threat: Biological Impacts and Mechanisms of Polystyrene Nanoplastics on Cells
pmc-11728749.creator: Wenxia Bu, Ye Cui, Yueyuan Jin, Xuehai Wang, Mengna Jiang, Ruiyao Huang, JohnPaul Otuomasiri Egbobe, Xinyuan Zhao, Juan Tang, Roberto Rosal
pmc-11728749.description: Polystyrene nanoplastics (PS-NPs), a pervasive component of plastic pollution, have emerged as a significant environmental and health threat due to their microscopic size and bioaccumulative properties. This review systematically explores the biological effects and mechanisms of PS-NPs on cellular systems, encompassing oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, DNA damage, inflammation, and disruptions in autophagy.

pmc-12385291.title: CRELD1-Associated Neurodevelopmental Disorder: Three New Individuals from Unrelated Families
pmc-12385291.creator: Jessica Archer, Shuxiang Goh, Christina Miteff, Sheridan O’Donnell, Kristen Park, Himanshu Goel, Antonio F Martínez-Monseny
pmc-12385291.description: Background: CRELD1 encodes a cell adhesion molecule initially implicated in atrioventricular septal defects (AVSDs). More recently, biallelic CRELD1 variants have been associated with syndromic and non-syndromic neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs). Methods: We describe three individuals from unrelated families with compound heterozygous CRELD1 variants, identified through exome sequencing. Clinical and genetic data were reviewed to delineate shared and divergent features.

pmc-12608336.title: Return to Work and Sports After Tibial Plateau Fracture Treatment: Are There Factors Associated with Faster Recovery?
pmc-12608336.creator: Tobias Resch, Lea Faber, Frederik Aasen-Hartz, Philipp Zehnder, Ahmed Ellafi, Peter Biberthaler, Frederik Greve, Łukasz Oleksy, Anna Mika
pmc-12608336.description: Background: The aim of this study was to separately assess return to work (RTW) and return to sports (RTS) rates and timelines following surgical and conservative treatment of tibial plateau fractures (TPF). A secondary objective was to identify factors associated with faster recovery.

pmc-12660086.title: Albumin-to-neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio: a novel dual-pathway biomarker for diabetic retinopathy risk assessment
pmc-12660086.creator: Chongyang She, Yong Tao, Shuo Yang
pmc-12660086.description: BackgroundDiabetic retinopathy (DR) represents a leading cause of blindness globally, with conventional risk factors inadequately explaining disease occurrence and progression. The albumin-to-neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio (ANLR), a composite biomarker integrating nutritional and inflammatory status, has shown predictive value in various diabetic complications but its relationship with DR remains unexplored.

pmc-13104466.title: Association between postoperative nocturnal blood pressure rising and mortality in patients receiving cardiac surgery: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13104466.creator: Wen-wen Song, Yi Liu, Qin-dong Liu, Long-he Xu, Han Gao, Yong-zhe Liu
pmc-13104466.description: ObjectivePostoperative blood pressure (BP) patterns may provide prognostic information in cardiac surgery patients, yet their clinical significance remains unclear. We investigated the association between early postoperative nocturnal BP rising and mortality in this population.Materials and methodsThis retrospective cohort study used the MIMIC-IV database (2008–2019) including adult patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) or valvular surgery.

pmc-13285235.title: Open diffusion magnetic resonance imaging and connectivity data for epilepsy and surgery: The IDEAS II release
pmc-13285235.creator: Peter N Taylor, Gerard Hall, Jonathan Horsley, Yujiang Wang, Sjoerd B Vos, Gavin P Winston, Andrew W McEvoy, Anna Miserocchi, Jane de Tisi, John S Duncan
pmc-13285235.description: ObjectiveEpileptic seizures are generated in cerebral networks that propagate ictal and interictal activity. The structure of cerebral networks underpinning epileptic activity can be inferred from diffusion‐weighted magnetic resonance imaging (DWI). However, publicly available DWI data in individuals with epilepsy are scarce, and processing is technically challenging due to scan‐specific artifacts, limiting research progress.

pmc-13448234.title: Interleukin-17 in disease pathogenesis and therapy: recent advances in targeted drug design and medicinal chemistry
pmc-13448234.creator: Jing Wen, Fan Liu, Ling Zhang, Linxin Lu, Shaojie Liang, Shufang Du
pmc-13448234.description: Interleukin-17 (IL-17) is a key pro-inflammatory cytokine that plays an essential role in host defense and immune regulation. Dysregulated IL-17 expression and signaling are implicated in the pathogenesis of a broad range of chronic inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, including psoriasis, systemic lupus erythematosus, periodontitis, and cancer.

pmc-13585461.title: Colchicine initiated before radiofrequency-induced injury attenuates left atrial inflammation, fibrosis, and susceptibility to atrial fibrillation
pmc-13585461.creator: Abir Attia, Charles-Alexandre LeBlanc, Ewen Le Quilliec, Feng Xiong, Martin G Sirois, Jean-François Tanguay, Jean-Claude Tardif, Martin Aguilar, Roddy Hiram
pmc-13585461.description: AimsAtrial fibrillation (AF) is the most frequently diagnosed cardiac arrhythmia. Catheter ablation using radiofrequency cauterization (CA-RFC) performed in the left atrium (LA) aims to isolate electrical sources of AF. This intervention is accompanied by frequent AF recurrences affecting 10% of patients at 30 days and 50% at one-year post-procedure. It has been suggested that inflammation could contribute to AF-recurrence post-CA-RFC.
